title: (No AI) Meta’s new One subscriptions put a price on social media and AI
author: Stevie Bonifield
content:
![Two visuals showing perks for Meta One Core and Premium plans](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/Meta-One-Bundle-plans-for-individuals.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Shortly after launching its new do-everything [AI assistant Muse](https://www.theverge.com/tech/993391/meta-muse-ai-hands-on), Meta's launching subscription bundles that pair its standalone app subscriptions with extra AI usage. Some of the new [Meta One bundles](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/09/introducing-meta-one-subscription-service-more-features-ai) were [in testing](https://www.theverge.com/tech/938500/facebook-whatsapp-instagram-meta-ai-subscriptions) earlier this year, but are now available globally starting today, with several tiers for individual users, creators, and businesses. Meta says the "core experience" on its apps and Meta AI will still be free, and users can still get its subscriptions for Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp without a bundle. It also says it plans to expand the bundles to include "Edits, AI glasses, and more over time."

title: (No AI) This doorbell camera lets a human security guard watch your front door
author: Jennifer Pattison Tuohy
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/SimpliSafe-Video-Doorbell-Series-2_06_250844.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

The new SimpliSafe Video Doorbell Series 2 adds 2K resolution and dual band Wi-Fi. | Image: Simplisafe

DIY home security company SimpliSafe is bringing its AI-powered proactive security feature to the front door. The new [SimpliSafe Video Doorbell Series 2](https://simplisafe.com/video-doorbell-series-2) launches today for $199.99 and works with the company's [Active Guard Outdoor Protection](https://www.theverge.com/2024/10/15/24268192/simplisafe-active-guard-outdoor-protection-live-monitoring-outdoor-camera) (starting at $49.99 a month). This combines AI analysis with live agents to detect potential threats and respond proactively.

When the camera detects suspicious activity - using a combination of on-device AI, cloud-based computer vision, and facial recognition - a SimpliSafe monitoring agent can drop in on the camera to "see, speak to, and attempt to deter potential intruders and package thieves," [accord …](https://support.simplisafe.com/articles/outdoor-cameras/what-is-simplisafe-active-guard-outdoor-protection)

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/995365/simplisafe-video-doorbell-series-2-virtual-guard-price-specs)
